name: Salmon & Sweetcorn Tacos
method: Roughly chop half the sweetcorn with the coriander and tomatoes and stir in the juice of one lime for a chunky salsa.
Shred the cabbage and toss it with the yoghurt, paprika, chilli flakes and the juice of the second lime.
Fry the salmon in the oil, skin-side down first, for 3 to 4 minutes each side until cooked through, then flake it into big pieces.
Warm the wraps. Fill with cabbage, salmon, salsa, sliced avocado and the rest of the sweetcorn.
